params.prompt: A candid, unretouched editorial photograph of a small-business owner taking a quiet coffee break at a refined but real small coastal cafe. One adult woman around forty in an ordinary white cotton shirt and dark trousers, seated on the right of the square composition. We see a relaxed three-quarter profile and a little of her face as she looks out toward the sea, unaware of the camera, no posed smile. The cup is resting on the small table, not being held; one relaxed hand rests beside it with naturally spaced fingers, the other rests in her lap. An ordinary phone in a slightly worn dark case lies face down, casually off-centre on the table. Simple cafe furniture with subtle wear, a faint coffee ring, some natural loose hairs and real fabric creases. Background is a believable coastal street terrace and softly receding sea, no fantasy resort or theatrical architecture. Eye-level observational photograph from a nearby seat, natural 50mm perspective, moderate depth of field so the subject and table are coherent while distant detail falls away gradually. Soft morning side light from one consistent direction, gentle shadow transitions, normal skin texture and variation, restrained natural colours, slight fine photographic grain, no HDR or artificial sharpening. Keep open sea and quiet negative space at the left for website text that will be added separately. The feeling is an authentic, restorative pause from work, understated and quietly premium. It must look like an actual location photograph, not a staged stock photo, beauty campaign, computer rendering or digital illustration. No skin smoothing, perfect plastic surfaces, exaggerated bokeh, dramatic colour grading, glossy CGI, excessive styling, text, logos, watermarks or floating interface graphics.
